---
title: "World café"
---

Four tables, about 15 minutes each. Hosts stay at their table; groups rotate. Everything goes onto **two Padlet boards** from your phone: scan the QR code or tap the button. The first time you post, Padlet asks for a name: use your first name.

```{python}
#| output: asis
import yaml, io, html
from pathlib import Path
import qrcode, qrcode.image.svg

v = yaml.safe_load(Path("_variables.yml").read_text())

def qr_svg(url):
    img = qrcode.make(url, image_factory=qrcode.image.svg.SvgPathImage, box_size=10, border=1)
    buf = io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf)
    s = buf.getvalue().decode()
    return s[s.find("<svg"):].replace("<svg", '<svg class="qr"', 1)

# Board -> its columns, in the order they appear on Padlet
boards = [
  ("Board 1 · World café", "Columns for Data, Method and Problem", v["padlet_cafe"], [
    ("Data", "#1f77b4", "Data: our messiest datasets",
     "The weirdest or messiest dataset you've worked with.",
     "Satellite imagery with cloud over every scene; GPS traces with gaps; geotagged social media posts; admin boundaries that change every census; surveys with inconsistent coding.",
     "Title: the dataset type. Body: the story. Vote for the messiest."),
    ("Method", "#d62728", "Method: I want to learn…",
     "A method you wish you knew…",
     "Causal inference (difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity); spatial econometrics; sensitivity analysis.",
     "Title: the method. Body: what you'd use it for."),
    ("", "#d62728", "Method: I can teach…",
     "…and one you could teach.",
     "Geospatial machine learning; remote sensing classification; network analysis.",
     "Title: the method. Look for a match in the column next door."),
    ("Problem", "#9467bd", "Problem: unlimited time & money",
     "The question you'd work on with unlimited time and money.",
     "“Where do displaced people go?” · “Can satellites measure poverty?” · “Who suffers most from heat?”",
     "Title only, 5 words max. Vote for your favourites; the top questions are pitched at the end."),
  ]),
  ("Board 2 · Our places", "A world map", v["padlet_place"], [
    ("Place", "#2ca02c", "Map: tap + and search a place",
     "A place your research has taken you, physically or digitally. More than one is welcome!",
     "Fieldwork in Beirut; flood maps of Karachi seen from space; mobility data across Ukraine; Liverpool neighbourhoods on Street View.",
     "Drop a pin, add a line about it. Add “(digital)” to the title if you got there remotely."),
  ]),
]

out = ['<table class="cafe"><thead><tr><th>Table</th><th>On Padlet</th><th>Prompt</th><th>Examples</th><th>How to post</th></tr></thead><tbody>']
for bname, bdesc, url, rows in boards:
    out.append(f'<tr class="board"><td colspan="5"><span class="bname">{html.escape(bname)}</span> '
               f'<span class="bdesc">{html.escape(bdesc)}</span>'
               f'<a class="btn-padlet board-btn" href="{html.escape(url)}" target="_blank">Open board ↗</a></td></tr>')
    for name, c, col, prompt, eg, how in rows:
        out.append(f'<tr style="--c:{c}"><td class="tname">{name}</td><td class="tcol">{html.escape(col)}</td>'
                   f'<td class="tprompt">{html.escape(prompt)}</td><td class="teg">{html.escape(eg)}</td>'
                   f'<td class="tviz">{html.escape(how)}</td></tr>')
out.append("</tbody></table>")

out.append('<h2>Scan to post</h2><div class="qrs">')
for bname, bdesc, url, rows in boards:
    out.append(f'<div class="qrbox"><div class="tname">{html.escape(bname)}</div>'
               f'<div class="bdesc">{" · ".join(dict.fromkeys(r[0] for r in rows if r[0]))}</div>{qr_svg(url)}</div>')
out.append("</div>")
print("\n".join(out))
```

## Table hosts

Keep the conversation going, make sure ideas land on the Padlet, and get ready to pitch your table's highlights (about 4 minutes) at 14:35.
